name: Image Codecs (WebP / AVIF)
description: Adds WebP + AVIF image decoders (bytes -> RGBA) so ground-truth comparisons in those formats get a perceptual difference score. Self-contained WASM (no system dependency); separately installable (run `node setup.mjs`) to keep the ~1.8 MB codecs out of the default install.
author: Glassbox
